name: Bewusst eingegangenes Depot-Risiko: Berater nennt die Entscheidung, draengt nicht
task: Sollte ich beim Sparziel __E2E__ ACR Hausanzahlung etwas umschichten?
setup_sql: SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ ACR Cash', finance.fn_create_account(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ ACR Cash','account_type','cash','currency','EUR'))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ ACR Depot', finance.fn_create_account(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ ACR Depot','account_type','stocks_depot','currency','EUR','settlement_id',(SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name='__E2E__ ACR Cash')))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ ACR Hausanzahlung', finance.fn_create_savings_goal(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ ACR Hausanzahlung','target_amount',14000,'target_date',(date_trunc('month', core.fn_today()) + interval '28 months' + interval '10 days')::date::text,'reserve_account_id',(SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name='__E2E__ ACR Depot'),'already_saved',14000))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ ACR Entscheidung', finance.fn_goal_depot_risk_fold((SELECT id FROM finance.savings_goals WHERE name='__E2E__ ACR Hausanzahlung'), finance.fn_goal_depot_risk_fold((SELECT id FROM finance.savings_goals WHERE name='__E2E__ ACR Hausanzahlung'), NULL)->'effective'->'depot_risk_shown'));
expected_behavior: The user asks whether to shift money of a savings goal whose depot risk they accepted on purpose (the snapshot list depot_risk marks it accepted). The advisor first names this as the user's own decision and lets them decide: it may give the figures from the database neutrally (advised maximum, amount above it, example loss, date of the last check) and list the options, but gives no own recommendation to sell (no I would sell). It books nothing. Recommending or urging to sell as if nothing had been decided is a FAIL.
notes: Sparziel unter 5 Jahren im Depot als bewusste Ausnahme (2026-11-06). Ziel + Entscheidung per setup_sql. Mock-Tier: kein Szenario noetig (kein Tool); geprueft wird nur im bezahlten Lauf (Judge).

name: Vereinbartes Sparziel im Abschnitt -> handoff_tasks, Antwort ohne Buchhalter
task: Ich bestaetige die Sektion goals_triggers wie von dir zusammengefasst: Wir wollen einen Notgroschen von 6000 Euro bis Ende 2027 ansparen, dafuer legen wir das Sparziel __E2E__ Notgroschen an. Keine weitere Rueckfrage noetig. Halte den Abschnitt goals_triggers mit dem vereinbarten Sparziel jetzt im Plan-Entwurf fest.
setup_sql: SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Konto', finance.fn_create_account(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Konto','account_type','cash','currency','EUR','opening_balance',1000))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt', finance.fn_create_recurring_payment(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt','account_id',(SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ Planfall Konto'),'direction','income','amount',5000,'schedule_unit','month','schedule_day_of_month',1,'first_payment_date',CURRENT_DATE::text)));
expected_behavior: The advisor calls tool_save_plan_section with section_key goals_triggers AND a handoff_tasks JSON array with exactly one entry of kind savings_goal whose payload carries the agreed figures (target 6000, end of 2027) and whose text is one plain German sentence naming the goal. The reply to the user does not mention a bookkeeper (Buchhalter), another agent, or that the advisor does not book; it says the goal is noted and comes at the end to go through. Under the test bypass the gate declines; the advisor then reports the save as not confirmed, not as done.
notes: Uebergabe Berater -> Buchhalter (E1/E2): Vereinbartes landet als handoff_tasks am Abschnitt, Laien-Sprache ohne Agenten-Namen. Einnahme per setup_sql wie ac16.

name: Lass uns das gleich eintragen -> tool_send_handoff_overview
task: Lass uns das Vereinbarte gleich eintragen, bevor wir weitermachen.
setup_sql: SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Konto', finance.fn_create_account(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Konto','account_type','cash','currency','EUR','opening_balance',1000))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt', finance.fn_create_recurring_payment(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt','account_id',(SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ Planfall Konto'),'direction','income','amount',5000,'schedule_unit','month','schedule_day_of_month',1,'first_payment_date',CURRENT_DATE::text))); INSERT INTO agent.handoff_tasks (domain, package, person_id, section_key, kind, text) SELECT 'finance', 'finance', agent.fn_owner_person_id(), 'goals_triggers', 'savings_goal', '__E2E__ Sparziel Notgroschen 6000 Euro bis Ende 2027';
expected_behavior: The advisor calls tool_send_handoff_overview (the list of agreed entries with the Go-through button) instead of telling the user to write a new message to someone else. It does not try to book anything itself and does not name a bookkeeper or another agent. A short plain sentence that the list is on its way is enough.
notes: Uebergabe Berater -> Buchhalter (E4): offene Aufgabe per setup_sql (Text mit __E2E__, fn_clear_e2e_data raeumt sie).

name: Idee ohne Zustimmung -> kein handoff_tasks-Eintrag
task: Ich bestaetige die Sektion retirement_pension wie von dir zusammengefasst: Die gesetzliche Rente und die bestehende Vorsorge bleiben die Basis, die Rentenluecke nehmen wir so hin. Den zusaetzlichen ETF-Sparplan fuer die Rente, den du vorgeschlagen hast, will ich nicht. Keine weitere Rueckfrage noetig. Speichere den Abschnitt retirement_pension ohne neuen Sparplan.
setup_sql: SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Konto', finance.fn_create_account(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Konto','account_type','cash','currency','EUR','opening_balance',1000))); SELECT pg_temp.ok('__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt', finance.fn_create_recurring_payment(jsonb_build_object('name','__E2E__ Planfall Gehalt','account_id',(SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ Planfall Konto'),'direction','income','amount',5000,'schedule_unit','month','schedule_day_of_month',1,'first_payment_date',CURRENT_DATE::text)));
expected_behavior: The advisor calls tool_save_plan_section with section_key retirement_pension and WITHOUT any handoff_tasks entry for a savings plan (handoff_tasks empty or omitted): the user declined the idea, so nothing is noted to enter. A handoff entry for the rejected savings plan is a FAIL.
notes: Uebergabe Berater -> Buchhalter (E1 Negativfall): nur Zugestimmtes wird vorgemerkt. Reiner Text-Abschnitt (ohne Kennzahlen-Block), damit der Berater ohne vorheriges Gespraech speichern kann.
